senses.gloss:
a. [cf. [[Uṇ. 5. 37]]] Black, dark-blue, dark-coloured; कुर्बन्नञ्जनमेचका इव दिशो मेघः समुत्तिष्ठते [[Mk. 5. 23]]; [[U. 6. 25]]; [[Me. 61]]; [[Rām. 5. 22. 26.]] 
-कः 
__1 Blackness, the dark-blue colour. 
__2 An eye of a peacock's tail; प्रेङ्खद्भूरिमयूखमेचकचयैः [[Māl. 6. 5.]] 
__3 A cloud. 
__4 Smoke. 
__5 A nipple. 
__6 A kind of gem. 
-कम् 
__1 Darkness. 
__2 Sulphuret of antimony. 
-Comp. 
-आपगा an epithet of the Yamunā. 
-गलः a peacock.
